title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Chip-led rebound, oil crushed, yields down. Tech’s bounce was narrow and low-volume, while falling oil and Treasury buyback news drove the macro tape. The session is a relief rally, not a trend reversal.

INDICES — VIX 15.4, below 20-day MA. SOXX +1.56%, QQQ +0.62%, IWM +0.42%, SPY +0.32%, DIA +0.30%. Large > small by 0.20pp. USO -4.58% was the standout cross-asset move. SPY and QQQ both above 200-day MA.

VOLUME — SPY and QQQ both at 0.6x avg — low-conviction bounce, no accumulation. IJH spiked 3.1x on flat price — churning. MAGS at 0.4x shows mega-cap neglect.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK +0.94%, XLC +0.77%, XLV +0.34%, XLU +0.21%, XLF +0.15%, XLRE +0.07%, XLB +0.00%, XLY -0.30%, XLI -0.34%, XLP -1.06%, XLE -1.66%. Top: URA +5.36%, WGMI +4.76%. Bottom: FCG -1.90%, USO -4.58%. Money out of energy into tech/uranium; staples bleeding as defensive trade unwinds. Rotation label: broadening participation.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.96 elevated — heavy protection demand despite rally. QQQ PCR 0.85 neutral, IV skew +8.1% shows put premium. QQQ gamma flip 710 vs spot ~710 — dealer hedging amplifies moves near this level.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil -4.58% vs equities + — transmission is clear: Hormuz mine clearance crushed crude, dragging XLE -1.66% while lifting TLT +1.10% on Bessent’s long-end buyback expansion. Dollar -0.07% with gold +0.32% — mild inverse.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 43.3 Neutral. Movers: ALB -5.89% (GF Value overvalued flag), AMD +4.91% (Raymond James upgrade), MP +4.79% (Pentagon rare-earth revenues), IJH -0.08% (3.1x vol spike). Watch: XBI +3.00% on 20d momentum break, AIQ +1.25% on 2.6x vol accumulation, JETS via 1.4x volume ahead of UAL’s route expansion.
